summary: The root ثجج (thjj) primarily describes the abundant and forceful flowing of water, blood, or other liquids. It implies a gushing or pouring forth in large quantities, often with intensity.

headwords.def: ثَجَّ ثج , (A, L, Msb, K,) aor. ثَجِجَ , (A, Msb, TA,) inf. n. ثَجٌّ , (L, Msb, TA,) or ثَجِيجٌ , (A, TA,) or ثُجُوجٌ , (TA,) It (water) flowed: (K:) or poured forth vehemently, (A, Msb, TA,) or much: or, as some say, it (much water) poured forth: (L, TA:) and and signify the same. (K.) ثَجٌّ also signifies The flowing of the blood of a victim brought for sacrifice to the sacred territory of Mekkeh. (S, K, TA.) ثَجَّهُ , (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K,) aor. ثَجُجَ , (S, A, Mgh, Msb,) inf. n. ثَجٌّ , (S, Mgh, Msb,) He made it to flow; (S, A, Mgh, Msb K;) poured it forth; (Msb;) namely, water, (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K,) and blood (S, A, Mgh, Msb) of a victim for sacrifice; (Mgh, Msb;) as also ; and may also be used in the same sense. (TA.) Hence, (Mgh, Msb,)

headwords.def: حَلَبَ فِيهِ ثَجًّا حلب فيه ثجا He milked into it milk abundantly flowing. (TA from a trad.)
ثَجُوجٌ ثجوج A source yielding abundance of water. (TA.) See also ثَجَّاجٌ .

headwords.gloss: A torrent; flow; The valley brought us its torrent

parts.t: The valley brought us its torrent,

headwords.def: ثَجِيجٌ ثجيج [originally an inf. n. (see 1)] A torrent, or flow. (S, K.) So in the saying, أَتَانَا الوَادِى بِثَجِيجِهِ [ The valley brought us its torrent, or flow ]. (S.) The sound of the pouring forth of water. (TA.) See also ثَجَّاجٌ .

headwords.gloss: pouring forth vehemently; poured forth; flowing

parts.t: (A.) Applied to water [or rain, and to blood,] it may have the meaning of a pass. part. n., or, which is preferable, that of an act. part. n. (IDrd, M.) [Hence,]
Such a one, his rain is such as pours forth vehemently, and his sea is noisy,
such a one is abundant in bounty

headwords.def: ثَجَّاجٌ ثجاج Water pouring forth vehemently: (Msb:) or poured forth; as also : (TA:) or flowing: (Har p. 138:) or flowing much: (Id. p. 393:) and rain pouring forth vehemently; (S, TA;) as also and : (TA:) and blood poured forth: (TA:) and a cloud pouring forth. (A.) Applied to water [or rain, and to blood,] it may have the meaning of a pass. part. n., or, which is preferable, that of an act. part. n. (IDrd, M.) [Hence,] فُلَانٌ غَيْثُهُ وَبَحْرُهُ عَجَّاجٌ (tropical:) [lit. Such a one, his rain is such as pours forth vehemently, and his sea is noisy, or copious: meaning such a one is abundant in bounty or munificence ]. (A.)

parts.t: who pours forth a copious flow of words.

headwords.def: مِثَجٌّ مثج : see ثَجَّاجٌ . Also, (K,) or خَطِيبٌ مِثَجٌّ , (A,) (tropical:) An eloquent, or able, speaker or orator; (K, TA;) who pours forth a copious flow of words. (TA.)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
